english: Would you like something to eat?

xrou: Adam thanatei punar caxra ghar baad-me.

english: I will do this for you.
I can do this for you.
I cannot do this without you.
xrou: Adam vai shakta kara etha vai-saha tumu.

english: I am leaving because I must.
For the sake of my family.
I am going to the house.
I will do it whether or not you agree.
xrou: Adam thanatei kara etha idias-athva-vai tumu sammati.

english: Take the road through the forest.
